instruction: Two Storey Warehouse IFC And Revit Structural Quantity Schedule CSV This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. In Revit, create a warehouse with a storage hall, an office mezzanine, and a regular steel frame, export the model as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, and export a Revit structural quantity schedule as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv in the Desktop. 1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv; C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc is at least 500 bytes and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv is at least 20 bytes. 2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema. 3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique. 4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities, 2 IfcSpace entities, 20 IfcColumn entities, 31 IfcBeam entities, 2 IfcSlab entities, 4 IfcWall entities, and 1 IfcRoof. 5. The IFC model contains at least 1 IfcStair, at least 2 IfcDoor entities, and at least 5 IfcWindow entities. 6. The IFC model contains 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy entities. 7. The normalized IfcSpace name list contains the tokens storage and office at least once each. 8. The shaped IFC product bounding-box X span is between 28.0 m and 32.0 m. 9. The shaped IFC product bounding-box Y span is between 17.0 m and 19.5 m. 10. The shaped IFC product bounding-box Z span is between 5.8 m and 7.0 m. 11. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv is a Revit schedule export with exactly the headers category,count in that order and exactly 4 non-empty data rows. 12. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv contains rows with these exact category and count values: columns=20, beams=31, slabs=2, walls=4. 13. The C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv counts for columns, beams, slabs, and walls match the IFC counts of IfcColumn, IfcBeam, IfcSlab, and IfcWall. Any item not explicitly required may vary.
